Chaos reigns when members of a dysfunctional family gather to bury a loved one. Son Daniel (Matthew MacFadyen) anticipates a face-off with his famous brother Robert (Rupert Graves), while cousin Martha (Daisy Donovan) and her fiancé Simon (Alan Tudyk) are desperate to make a good impression on her father. In the midst of the family turmoil, a mystery guest threatens to bring the deceased's skeleton out of the closet.

Young Keda tries to survive alone in the wilderness after he's left for dead during his first hunt with his Cro-Magnon tribe. He soon forms an unlikely alliance with a lone wolf that was abandoned by its pack. Facing overwhelming odds and nonstop danger, Keda and the wolf must now trek through a harsh and unforgiving landscape to make it home before winter.

Jaime Reyes suddenly finds himself in possession of an ancient relic of alien biotechnology called the Scarab. When the Scarab chooses Jaime to be its symbiotic host, he's bestowed with an incredible suit of armor that's capable of extraordinary and unpredictable powers, forever changing his destiny as he becomes the superhero Blue Beetle.

A magical board game unleashes a world of adventure on siblings Peter and Judy Shepherd. While exploring an old mansion, the youngsters find a curious, jungle-themed game called Jumanji in the attic. When they start playing, they free Alan Parrish, who's been stuck in the game's inner world for decades. If they win Jumanji, the kids can free Alan for good, but that means braving giant bugs, ill-mannered monkeys and even stampeding rhinos!

p.t: Journey to the Center of the Earth
p.d: During an expedition to Iceland, professor Trevor Anderson (Brendan Fraser), his nephew Sean (Josh Hutcherson) and their guide, Hannah (Anita Briem), get trapped in a cavern. As they follow their only escape route deeper and deeper below the Earth's surface, they pass through strange places and encounter incredible creatures, including dinosaurs. But as volcanic activity around them increases, they realize they must find their way out -- soon.

When timid bank clerk Stanley Ipkiss (Jim Carrey) discovers a magical mask containing the spirit of the Norse god Loki, his entire life changes. While wearing the mask, Ipkiss becomes a supernatural playboy exuding charm and confidence which allows him to catch the eye of local nightclub singer Tina Carlyle (Cameron Diaz). Unfortunately, under the mask's influence, Ipkiss also robs a bank, which angers junior crime lord Dorian Tyrell (Peter Greene), whose goons get blamed for the heist.

This film adaptation of a Roald Dahl work tells the story of Matilda Wormwood (Mara Wilson), a gifted girl forced to put up with a crude, distant father (Danny DeVito) and mother (Rhea Perlman). Worse, Agatha Trunchbull (Pam Ferris), the evil principal at Matilda's school, is a terrifyingly strict bully. However, when Matilda realizes she has the power of telekinesis, she begins to defend her friends from Trunchbull's wrath and fight back against her unkind parents.

His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble.

Drunk and in love, Ravi and Pratiksha impulsively decide to marry. A horrified Kavya witnesses the scene and tries to intervene, but can she stop them in time?
Megha uncovers a secret on Manoj's phone during their wedding. Everyone becomes worried that the truth might tear them apart.
Mainadevi holds Shiva responsible for the danger. The gods become shocked when Shiva asks Vishnu to marry Parvati.
Uma instructs Narayan to disguise himself as Shiva to convince Parvati about marriage, while Narayan impersonates Shiva and meets Parvati at Shiva's behest.
The contestants are surprised when they are tasked with baking a cake. With a set of imposing guidelines, the chefs go to extreme lengths to impress the judges.
Megha uncovers a secret on Manoj's phone during their wedding. Everyone becomes worried that the truth might tear them apart.
Durga is out to avenge the crimes committed by Shaurya, a playboy and the scion of the powerful Goenka family of Kolkata.
The responsible son of a middle-class family crosses paths with the arrogant daughter of a wealthy businessman, leading to the lives of Ramachari and Charu forever being changed.
Parvati senses something amiss and challenges Narayan to reveal his true identity. Enraged by their deceitful actions, Parvati transforms into Shakti.
Shiva graciously accepts Mainavati's request to be referred to as a mother instead of a mother-in-law, and Mainavati presents Parvati's hand in marriage to Shiva.
Pratiksha claims Kavya drugged her into signing divorce papers. Shocked, Ravi wants Pratiksha back. Will she reconcile with him?
After her would-be-husband runs away from his wedding, abandoned bride Megha faces up to her heartbreak as she sets out on a journey of self-discovery whilst trying to navigate a judgemental society.

Stan ist ziemlich nervös, weil die Terror-Alarmstufe erhöht wurde und "sie" überall sein könnten. Derweil verkündet Steve, dass er das begehrteste Mädchen seiner Schule, Cheerleader Lisa Silver, zu einem Date einladen will und kommt schnell zu dem Schluss, dass ihm dabei ein Hund nützlich sein könnte.

Francine steigt zur erfolgreichen Immobilienmaklerin auf, was Stan in seiner Männlichkeit kränkt, weil sie plötzlich weit mehr als er verdient. Um den Status quo wieder herzustellen, ist Stan zu den radikalsten Mitteln bereit, inklusive eines Kidnappings ins berüchtigte Gefangenencamp Guantánamo.
Hal ist mit seinem Einkommen nicht zufrieden und nimmt daher einen zweiten Job an. Seine Söhne sind darüber zunächst froh, doch dann bestellt ihr Vater einen Babysitter für sie.

Malcolm und Stevie sind die einzigen Gäste auf Dabneys Geburtstag. Dabneys Mutter ist eine Glucke, die ihren Sohn einfach nicht aufwachsen lassen kann. Als sie darauf besteht, dass er ihr die Haare bürstet, wird er rebellisch.

Malcolm und seine Freunde machen bei einem akademischen Achtkampf mit. Ihr Lehrer will den Wettkampf unbedingt gewinnen und schreckt auch vor Betrug nicht zurück. Malcolm ist damit nicht einverstanden.

Lois und Hal unternehmen einen neuen Versuch, ihr Testament zu schreiben, doch schon schnell streiten sie sich. Sie werfen sich gegenseitig vor, kläglich versagt zu haben in Sachen Erziehung und Geld.

Als Sams Vater Woodstone besucht, stellt Patience die Vater-Tochter-Beziehung der beiden auf die Probe. Isaac muss mit den Nachwirkungen seiner Trennung von Nigel fertig werden. Thor und Flower stehen vor einer unangenehmen Situation mit Nancy.
Sam will die fromme Patience besänftigen. Diese glaubt aber mittlerweile, dass Sam eine Hexe ist.

Trevor, der sich durch Catfishing einen Job als Finanzanalyst ergattert hat, gerät in Schwierigkeiten, als er persönlich zu einem obligatorischen Betriebsausflug gerufen wird. Hetty und Sass verbreiten ein Gerücht über Pete.

Nachdem Claire fast zwei Unfälle gebaut hat, fordert sie ein Stoppschild für die Kreuzung. Dafür muss sie allerdings 50 Unterschriften sammeln. Mit der Hilfe ihrer Familie kann sie jedoch nicht rechnen, denn diese hat genug zu tun.

Claires Vorschlag für ein Stoppschild wurde vom amtierenden Stadtrat Duane Bailey abgelehnt. Daher schlägt ihr Phil vor, sich selbst für das Amt zu bewerben. Er passt im Gegenzug dazu auf die Kinder auf, was aber nicht so einfach ist.

Phil will Haley sein altes College zeigen, was Haley als besonders peinlich empfindet. Auch die betrunkene und leicht bekleidete Claire gerät in eine heikle Situation vor versammelter Mutterschaft. Gloria und Jay machen eine überraschende Entdeckung.

Haley muss einen Aufsatz fürs College schreiben, doch ihr fällt zu dem geforderten Thema nichts ein. Cameron ist sich sicher, trotz seiner Homosexualität, sehr gut bei den Frauen anzukommen. Daraufhin schließt Mitchell mit ihm eine Wette ab.

Nach einem Brand haben die Nachbarn von Claire und Phil alles verloren. Claire mobilisiert ihre Familie, um ihnen zu helfen. Dabei verrenkt sich Jay seinen Rücken und muss seinen Schwiegersohn widerwillig um einen Gefallen bitten. Derweil hat auch Cameron Sorgen. Denn er glaubt, dass Haley und Alex Witze über seine Sexualität machen. Claire hat mit ihrer Eifersucht auf das Verhältnis zwischen Mitchell und Gloria zu kämpfen.

Stan löscht versehentlich Francines Gedächtnis, sodass sie denkt, dass sie im Jahr 1985 leben würde. Er muss alle Hebel in Bewegung setzen, um sie zurück in die Gegenwart zu holen, auch die Entführung von Whitney Houston stellt da ein angebrachtes Mittel dar. Steve überwindet unterdessen seine Angst und fragt Lindsay Coolidge, ob sie mit ihm gehen will.

Monica and Phoebe host Rachel's baby shower but forget to invite her mother. Rachel realises she is clueless about caring for the baby after birth. Meanwhile, Joey auditions to host a new game show called 'Bamboozled'.

When Monica's cooking at the restaurant receives a harsh write-up in a newspaper, she goes to a criticism class taught by the reviewer, hoping to convince him to reconsider his opinion. Meanwhile, Rachel gets upset when a cute salesgirl flirts with Ross while he and Rachel are shopping for baby supplies, and nervous about a major job interview, Chandler receives some questionable coaching from Phoebe.
Eight days overdue, Rachel grows irritable, prompting a bet between Monica and Phoebe. Meanwhile, Joey invites Chandler to his new film's screening.
Rachel waits in the hospital maternity ward with an anxious Ross. To her dismay, she is put in a semi-private room. Then, the heavily pregnant Janice is assigned to share the room with her.
Rachel doubts Ross's commitment to her and the baby. Meanwhile, Ross wants to confess his love for Rachel. Joey discovers Ross's mother's engagement ring on the floor.

Due to a misunderstanding, Rachel finds herself engaged to Joey instead of Ross shortly after giving birth to her and Ross's baby girl. Meanwhile, Joey can't help taking a look as Rachel tries unsuccessfully to nurse her baby. Inspired to have a baby of their own, Monica and Chandler retire to a hospital cupboard for a little privacy.

Joey's futile attempts to gain Ross's forgiveness for mistakenly asking Rachel to marry him only result in emergency hospitalisation. Meanwhile, an exhausted Rachel desperately searches for a solution to end baby Emma's non-stop crying.

Rachel's constant calls to Emma's paediatrician force him to reject her as a patient. Meanwhile, Chandler plans to move to Tulsa for work, but worries about whether career-minded Monica is still willing to join him, and Joey and Phoebe agree to find each other companions for a double date.

Phoebe fears losing her latest prospective boyfriend Mike and her self-doubt is not helped by Ross' careless comments. Meanwhile, Chandler is in Tulsa on a work assignment, and when Monica surprises him in his hotel room, she mistakenly thinks that he has a sexual fetish for sharks.

While Phoebe and Joey wait at a fancy restaurant for their friends' arrival to celebrate Phoebe's birthday, Rachel is delayed because she is afraid to leave Emma with a babysitter. Monica and Chandler also fail to arrive on time after having a row about Chandler's urge to resume smoking and then giving in to other urges.
Ross mocks Rachel's new male nanny, and Chandler becomes upset when Monica says that somebody from her job is the funniest guy she's ever met.

When Chandler's former romantic rival intends to sell his flat, insecure Chandler persuades Joey to help him secretly inspect it and the guys are shocked to discover an old videotape featuring Monica having sex with Richard.

On the night before Thanksgiving, Rachel's self-centred younger sister Amy ruins everyone's holiday dinner with her uncensored observations. Meanwhile, Monica obsessively protects her good wedding china, and Joey forgets to join his television cast mates in the big Thanksgiving parade.

Rachel impulsively gives a handsome restaurant patron her telephone number, and worries that he'll call when Ross is in their apartment. Meanwhile, Phoebe's boyfriend Mike and Ross desperately try to find something in common to talk about when they babysit Emma, and Chandler returns from Tulsa to visit Monica, but must hide from Joey after rejecting his offer of free basketball tickets.

Chandler is forced to remain in Tulsa over the Christmas period due to a major deadline at work, and Monica fears the worst when she finds out that he will be joined in Tulsa by a beautiful colleague Wendy. While he works, Chandler recalls some of the more embarrassing moments from previous holidays shared with his friends.
Caroline is impressed with Charlie's work around the house, but he finds more than he bargained for in her bathroom.
Featuring a thieving T. rex, a felon stuck in a sewer, and a robbery foiled by an escalator.
Featuring a streaker amongst a group of sea lions and a carjacking bear.
Featuring a tank on the run, juvenile offenders, and a cheerleader with anger issues.
Featuring terrible truckers, feathered offenders, and a reptile on the run.
Featuring a robber on a roof, offenders in an office, and a criminal in a canal.
Crime, chaos and craziness including a courtroom crooner and mischievous monkeys.
Unconventional criminal acts including a not so high-speed pursuit of a lawnmower.
More moronic misdemeanours featuring a proposal in handcuffs and bears on the rampage.
Featuring bad getaways, OAP offenders, and a bus load of trouble!
Featuring a mooning on a motorway, OAPs fighting on a zebra crossing, and a man that takes the term Drive-through a bit too literally.

In 2015 a man visits a tarot card reader. Within an hour she's dealt out the death card, and he's confessed to a murder.

In 1993, 16-year-old Claire Tiltman is found dying by the roadside. Her killer disappears into the night. More than 20 years later, Colin Ash Smith is finally brought to trial. Jurors hear of how he knew Claire.
A wife vanishes after her husband moves his mistress into the family home. Ten years later a yachting accident reveals the dark truth behind the woman's disappearance.
Documentary examining the terrible truth about the death of loving wife Colette Daffin, mowed down in a hit-and-run accident in Derbyshire 2009.
Examining the sex abuse scandal which occurred in the North of England and appeared to go undetected for quite some time.

John Sweeney brutally murdered two of his girlfriends, dismembered their bodies and dumped them in canals. In a macabre twist, he hid clues in his abstract paintings, and five other girlfriends of his are currently still missing.
Tyler Kerry travelled to Turkey with his family to make memories. Days later, he vanished from their hotel. When his body is found, questions remain over what happened.
While in Jamaica, aspiring model and filmmaker Desiree fell victim to a deadly attack. To date, no arrests have been made as her family desperately seek answers.
A family holiday to Aruba turns into every parent's nightmare when 14-year-old Max DeVries vanishes during a jet ski trip and never returns.

In Cle Elum, Washington, Casey lost her dream home to a stranger who claimed it as her own for over 4 months and even tried to rent rooms out to other people for profit. But when Flash and his team move in, will their tactics be enough?

In Cleveland, Ray is ready to move back home-until he discovers an intruder linked to his previous tenant has taken over his house. When Flash and his team step inside, it's anything but a routine squatter removal job.
Edward Ates takes a polygraph test with former FBI agent George Olivo in a bid to show his innocence.
When 31-year-old real estate appraiser Mike Williams mysteriously vanishes while duck hunting in the Florida swamps in December 2000, authorities suspect he accidentally drowned.

When Sherry Leighty goes missing in 1999, her family is left wondering how a dedicated mother of three could vanish without a trace. A decade later, the cold case heats up when Sherry's sister launches a social media campaign.

In early 1984, three-year-old Vanessa Bennett becomes the lone survivor of her family's brutal murder. Initial investigators suspect a serial killer is at large, but decades pass before DNA narrows the suspect pool to one man.
Nika and Chris fight machine breakdowns and water problems, but a new crew member may turn their fortunes around.
The competition shifts into high gear of hilarity as teams take over Helsinki with their homemade soapbox cars during the Red Bull Soapbox Race 2019.
All the thrills and spills from the 2013 Red Bull Soapbox Race in London, as the crews unleash their four-wheeled, motorless creations on a downhill course littered with obstacles.

Bob Mortimer returns to his childhood roots in Middlesbrough to fish the River Esk and Tees with his dear friend and angling mentor Paul Whitehouse. As well as trying to catch the glorious grayling, Bob is also going to try to ignite the joy of Christmas in Paul, who thinks the magic of the season has been long-lost to commercialism.
Lee Mack is joined by Dr Christian Jessen and Diane Parish, and David Mitchell is joined by Gabby Logan and Andy Hamilton.
Lee Mack is joined by Bob Mortimer and Patsy Kensit and David Mitchell is joined by Greg Davies and Richard Osman.
David Mitchell is joined by Jack Whitehall and Emily Maitlis, and Lee Mack is joined by Jim Carter and Armando Iannucci.

Rob Brydon is back in the host's chair for the seventh series of the comedy panel show. As ever, David Mitchell and Lee Mack are the lightning-quick team captains. Over the course of each show, celebrity guests reveal amazing stories about themselves, some of which are true and some of which are not. In this episode, Lee and David are joined by Rhod Gilbert, Vernon Kay, Dara O Briain and Denise Van Outen.

Simon Reeve continues his travels along the Tropic of Capricorn, the line of latitude that cuts across South Africa, South America and Australia. On the Australian west coast, Simon witnesses the migration of the humpback whale. He meets a tough outback couple refusing to leave an asbestos polluted ghost town and a farmer attempting to eke a living out of a dust bowl.
Guy goes to work one mile below the North Sea in the UK's last deep mine.
Five celebrities and their dogs take on the world of competitive dog training, learning new skills, building on their relationships with their pets, and vying to be Wagging Rights champion.

p.t: Have I Got a Bit More News for You [NEW]
p.d: Steph McGovern is host, with guest panellists actor Stephen Mangan and broadcaster Salma Shah joining team captains Paul Merton and Ian Hislop.
Stephen and Alan are joined by Jo Brand, Liza Tarbuck, and Sue Perkins as they explore why jelly appears to be alive, what diseases afflict fishermen, and the many uses of pigs.
Dara Ó Briain and Hugh Dennis bring the series to a close with a special edition of the topical comedy show featuring the best bits and unseen material.
Dara O Briain and Hugh Dennis are joined by Maisie Adam, Angela Barnes, Rhys James, Eshaan Akbar and Alasdair Beckett-King.

The Volvo Amazon 122 is a classic Swedish auto with true rally heritage. Mike travels to the Pacific Northwest, where he has tracked down a true barn find. Ant is tasked to make it roadworthy before the boys know the true scope of the work ahead.
Mike gets his hands dirty preparing the Bronco for the biggest collector car auction in the world, Barrett Jackson.
Typically, our journey with off-grid builds ends with the final nail; we're catching up with a couple in Georgia and a family in Tennessee's Smoky Mountains.
A couple looks to build an eco-friendly, off-the-grid geodesic dome, cooled using geothermal caves, with a view of Tennessee's South Cumberland Mountain Range.
A musician and college student wants an off-the-grid treehouse compound with three structures, each serving living and sustainability, in the Arkansas woods.

The Raneys find a Montana homestead struggling through food, predator and power problems. Marty and Matt reunite them with old firefighter squad mates who help consolidate and build out a couple's homestead for safety and accessibility.

The Raneys rescue a single-father homesteader facing threats of rock slides and bears in a Montana box canyon. But with Matt in Alaska awaiting the birth of his daughter, Marty and Misty face an uphill battle.

Homesteaders too proud to admit failure are surprised when loved ones secretly call for an intervention. Facing a new range of challenges and emotions, the Raneys must race to save not just the homestead, but often the fractured families themselves.

The Barnwood Builders fight through mud and heat to turn the salvaged Shaver House into a two-story lake house in Alabama; Mark experiments with new construction products; everyone ends up in the lake.

p.t: In the Eye of the Storm
p.d: Groundbreaking storytelling techniques reveal the high-stakes drama that unfolds at the epicenter of recent natural disasters, as told through firsthand accounts and mobile phone footage filmed by everyday people caught in the eye of the storm.
Being a truck driver isn't easy: long hours, huge loads and busy roads are just some of the issues they face. Truckers from Germany, Italy and Holland share some of their journeys.

Of all the different years and generations of the VW Bug, there is one that stands out among the rest, which is the Hebmüller. There are maybe 200 of them left, so in addition to being hard to find, they are truly the holy grail of VWs.

The VW Bug build continues, and the challenge is to keep what makes the car a Hebmueller intact, while taking bold steps to turn it into a hot rod. Dave keeps the traditional two-tone exterior, but modifying it to an automatic is a huge test.

Normally when Kindig-It Design attends a car show, their cars are the ones being judged. This time around, Dave and Kev hold the keys and will have to select the top 10 builders out of the hundreds of cars that arrive for the show.
The pinnacle of BMW is the modern classic, the E46 M3. Mike finds one with the subframe already fixed, and he challenges Ant to transform the transmission with new tech.

A shipping catastrophe occurs when a massive container vessel runs aground and completely blocks one of the most vital trade routes on the planet; experts investigate and uncover critical wind conditions and potential navigational errors.

A vital hillside motorway in Pennsylvania is destroyed in just minutes after a catastrophic landslide rocks a community; engineers investigate and uncover undetected geological issues with an increased and unstable traffic load.
Bruce is keen to find some World War Two objects linked to D-Day and in doing so makes an amazing discovery.
Bruce gets hold of an extremely rare, and valuable, German Panther tank, and its original undercoat is more pink than camouflage. But getting parts is a struggle.
At Biggin Hill, Bruce visits a collector's haul of WWII Spitfires. Plus, the twins prepare some WWII artillery guns to export to Australia, but it's no easy feat.

Starting out from Chicago on his ludicrous American Chopper, Henry Cole is making his way through Oklahoma on iconic Route 66; braving 90-degree heat and bouts of torrential rain and meeting plenty of colourful characters along the way.

Crossing the deserts en-route to California, Henry Cole is greeted by stifling heat and zero humidity, not to mention the assortment of UFO hunters, gunslingers, eccentric millionaires and crazy rednecks.
Henry Cole completes his journey, defying the elements. Will he think Route 66 still rates as one of the greatest rides on earth or is its magical allure slowly becoming a thing of the past?

In 373 B.C., the Greek city of Helike vanished; archaeologists believe they've found the ruins of the great lost metropolis; using CGI, experts re-create the city's final moments and reveal its links to the greatest lost land of all -- Atlantis.
The lost city of Olous: A great metropolis submerged in the Mediterranean; archaeologists uncover its secrets using pioneering technology and CGI reconstruction.

The Pantheon is a 2,000-year-old temple with a secret; using cutting-edge archaeological methods and brand-new evidence, experts look beneath the streets of Rome to find out why it was built and how it survived so long.
French polisher Alex struggles with an old billiards table that proves difficult to restore. Meanwhile, Martin takes on the challenge of a rare and valuable set of Ferrari luggage.
Sculptor Nick attempts the restoration of a rare piece of folk history. Meanwhile, leather restorer Martin is brought a globe-trotting antique luxury French travelling trunk.
Engineer Bo works to get a vintage model aeroplane back in action. Meanwhile, French polisher Alex battles to breathe new life into a rickety cabinet.
Henry and Fuzz meet a lifelong biker with unique motorbikes. Fuzz discovers a 1950s step-through scooter, but Henry prefers low-capacity sports bikes.

When an indoor hotel walkway collapses in Kansas City, Mo., it becomes the most deadly engineering disaster in U.S. history; experts investigate and uncover evidence of a catastrophic design change in the support system construction.

Find out how exercise bikes, Cornish pasties, pasta makers, and slate products are made.
Find out how channel signs are created, wetsuits are manufactured, and aluminium aircraft are made.
More everyday items go under microscope. How are objects including aircraft cabinets and motorcycle brake locks produced?
Join the crew as they explore the origins, inner workings and technical specs of the Audi S8.
Picture your dream car - does it look like an Ultima Evolution? The crew go to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.
How do they weave a traditional Turkish carpet? How do they use helicopter blade technology to make cross country skis? How do they turn the water on and off at Niagara Falls?
The crew go to the birthplace of the Jaguar XF, revealing the inner workings and stunning exterior.
Kevin Delaney and his team of experts show how explosive hydrogen peroxide can really be. Plus, combining ping pong balls with pressurised liquid nitrogen.
Kevin and his team of experts explore the amazing science behind rockets, using unconventional materials to power homemade projectiles to incredible heights.
Kevin and the team take to the streets to create a massive, swirling fire tornado out of kerosene. They dazzle onlookers with a rainbow-coloured flamethrower.
Kevin and his team of experts use a race car to put a new twist on an old magic trick, and show what it takes to build a homemade hovercraft.

Confidential CIA files reveal a top-secret war for space between the US and the Soviets, and a team of experts investigates if new discoveries about American espionage during the Apollo program provide evidence of a conspiracy.
Experts investigate Apollo 11's lunar module that nearly killed Neil Armstrong during training. Some believe this proves why the moon landing is fake.
How are mountain bike suspensions, surgical sutures, grain dryers, and frying pans made?
See how downhill ski bindings, immersion parts washers, mining ventilation and pencil sharpeners are made.

Clayton must haul his 20,000-pound dinosaur fossil over 200 miles to a lab where it will finally be identified. The Harris/Bolan clan chases poachers off of their land and Jared makes a last-ditch effort to bring in some money this season.

Today the Shed and Buried boys are moving on to Hertfordshire, where they find vintage cars, obscure tractors and rare British bikes from the 1950s. It's all going well, but when the haggling starts, things don't turn out quite how anyone expected.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, the pair are in the Cotswolds where they discover sheds full of stationary engines, obscure agricultural implements and some very surprising collections of memorabilia. Moving on up to Sussex, they go behind the scenes at one of Britain's most famous bike shops, and find in its dark corners and dusty attics, two extraordinary hidden gems.

In this episode, Henry and Sam are uncovering vintage treasures in West Sussex. They go behind the scenes at one of Britain's most famous bike shops, and in its dark corners and dusty attics find two extraordinary hidden gems.
Richard wants to take the business to a whole new level by using the power of social media and embracing his role as Cog brand ambassador, resulting in an intrepid trip to the Middle East.

The Cog re-sprays an Aston Martin Lagonda a shocking pink for Europe's biggest car collector. Richard's daughter Izzy discovers a passion for racing. Richard gets carried away and enters them into a race, prompting a bout of parental nerves.
Things appear to be on the up when they land a prestigious Morgan job, but a disastrous E-Type re-build prompts an emergency audit by Richard's mum. The verdict is damning.

Henry and Fuzz visit Jimmy's place near Swindon, filled with exclusive vintage military vehicles, and try to solve the intricacies of a Ferret scout car's epicyclic gearbox.

In Peru zieht ein heftiges Unwetter auf und im Amazonas-Regenwald schüttet es wie aus Eimern. Jetzt rächt sich, dass Amber, Trish und Jen ihren Unterschlupf nicht mit ausreichend Palmblättern abgedichtet haben. So etwas wird direkt bestraft.

p.t: Naked Survival - Ausgezogen in die Wildnis
p.d: Die hohe Luftfeuchtigkeit fördert im Kerriwong-Wald im Süden Thailands das Wachstum giftiger Pflanzen sowie zahlloser Insekten, darunter Mückenschwärme, die Dengue- und Zika-Viren übertragen.

p.t: Naked Survival - Ausgezogen in die Wildnis
p.d: Auf den Philippinen musste Skye aufgeben. Dort wurde sie wegen stechender Schmerzen und einer drohenden Infektion von Sanitätern evakuiert. Jetzt bekommt sie in Thailand eine zweite Chance.
Das Team Salvage soll eine Jacht mit gebrochenem Kiel zu einer Bootswerft schleppen.
Bei der Rettung einer Jacht bleiben die Fahrzeuge des Teams nacheinander im Schlamm stecken.
Das Team soll einen riesigen schwimmenden Ponton entfernen, der immer wieder Schwierigkeiten macht.

Im dichten Verkehrsnetz Londons geraten Kontrolleure und Ermittler täglich an ihre Grenzen. Routinekontrollen in Bus und U-Bahn eskalieren schnell, Diskussionen werden laut und nicht jeder Fahrgast bleibt kooperativ. Parallel jagt ein Team einen besonders cleveren Wiederholungstäter: Über Monate täuscht er mit seiner Oyster-Card kürzere Strecken vor und spart so regelmäßig Fahrgeld. Während die Fahnder ihm endlich auf die Spur kommen, entwickelt sich eine Kontrolle plötzlich zum Polizeieinsatz.

Während der Stoßzeit im Nahverkehr geraten die Kontrolleure mehrfach an ihre Grenzen: Eine Frau ohne gültiges Ticket weigert sich hartnäckig, ihre Personalien anzugeben, die Polizei muss eingreifen. An einem Umsteigeknoten wird ein Mann erwischt, der die Kontrolleure sogar wegstößt, um zu flüchten. Parallel verfolgen Ermittler eine junge Frau, die sich ständig Geld für angeblich nicht genutzte Fahrten zurückerstatten lässt.

Nach zwei Millionen Dollar Gewinn in drei Wochen testet Parker Schnabel nun den Claim am Sulphur Creek mit neuen Baggern. Gleichzeitig versucht Kevin Beets, Personalprobleme durch den erfahrenen Maschinenführer und Schweißer Buzz Legault zu lösen.

Parker Schnabels Karriere als Minenboss beginnt während der Schulferien. Sein Großvater John schenkt ihm Vertrauen und überträgt ihm seinen Claim. Parker muss bis zum Ende der Saison 75 Unzen Gold fördern, um den Betrieb am Laufen zu halten. Kevin Beets pachtet am Scribner Creek Land von seinem Vater Tony, um aus dessen Schatten herauszutreten. Rick Ness arbeitet als Vorarbeiter, bevor ihm die Verantwortung zufällt. Gezeigt wird, wie die drei Männer diese Herausforderungen gemeistert haben.

p.t: The Last Woodsmen - Holzfäller am Limit
p.d: In zwei Tagen trifft der erste Holzkahn ein. Doch bevor Jared Douglas und sein Team am Forever Claim kostbare Baumstämme verladen können, müssen sie sich zunächst um ein anderes Problem kümmern.

p.t: The Last Woodsmen - Holzfäller am Limit
p.d: Auf dem ersten Kahn fehlte Holz im Wert von 50.000 Dollar. Damit Jared Douglas sein schwimmendes Lager nicht verliert, muss er die Produktion auf vier Fuhren pro Tag erhöhen. Eine seiner Mitarbeiterinnen soll dabei eine Schlüsselrolle übernehmen.

p.t: Die Monster-Jäger - Bestien auf der Spur
p.d: Buck und seine Gefährten versuchen gemeinsam, eine rätselhafte Inschrift zu entschlüsseln, die Buck in einer Hütte abfotografiert hat und die auch auf einem Felsüberhang zu finden ist. Zudem taucht die mysteriöse Gestalt mit dem Umhang auf.

p.t: Die Monster-Jäger - Bestien auf der Spur
p.d: Das AIMS-Team begibt sich im Tygart Valley in West Virginia auf eine Mission, die Trapper vor seinem Tod für sie vorbereitet hat. Ausgestattet mit seinem Tagebuch werden sie von ihrem Anführer aus dem Grab heraus in ihr wildestes Abenteuer geführt.

p.t: Die Monster-Jäger - Bestien auf der Spur
p.d: Während sie ihre Fallen bauen, hören Willy und Bill ein furchterregendes Brüllen. Mithilfe von Trappers Notizen findet das Team einen genialen Weg, um die Fußspuren des Tieres zu finden. Dabei stoßen sie außerdem auf ein geheimnisvolles Grab.

Prior to the annual classic car show in Los Angeles, the guys need to shake down a 1962 Corvette and make some design adjustments to a '55 Mercedes Gullwing. Meanwhile, Kevin hunts for new ideas and rare finds in Los Angeles.

A road warrior from Alaska arrives to add some improvements to an already solid build. To enhance performance, a new exhaust and tips are custom fabricated, as a new set of wheels, tires and a custom interior.
A simple yet classy Pontiac Tempest arrives for a ground-up build. But after the car is completely stripped, things get complicated.
The Pontiac Tempest build continues as bodywork is completed and Dave has designed a killer new colour. Kevin shows off his powder-coating skills on a custom chassis.
When a beat-up Chevy truck rolls into the yard, Andy thinks it's too valuable to crush. Bobby isn't pleased when Andy decides to flip it, but Andy sees dollar signs.

Andy gives Bobby the keys to his Cooper to flip, but the Mini has major issues. With his father occupied, Andy takes on projects Bobby would never approve of, including a vintage beach cruiser build and a load of Porsche race cars.
Richard finds a classic mini that needs restoring. And, with the costs of the new workshop escalating, he sells some of his own cars to help pay for the business.
Some of the precious classic cars and motorbikes go to auction with no reserve. Meanwhile, Neil and Anthony get to work on a mystery vehicle from the 1930s.

Richard enforces a major workshop clear-out. A friend and classic car restorer explains to him how much more they'll need to do if they're to convince the Ministry of Defence to trust them with an important historical restoration project.

Richard brings in a business consultant to make efficiencies but not everyone approves. The Cogs test run the new way of working on a classic Fiat. Corgi request to make a model of Richard's RS2000. The Workshop's very first restoration project.
Forrest combs the Florida Everglades for the black panther, which has never been seen in the US. Discoveries in the area suggest it may be more than a rumour and there is one roaming around.

Forrest is in the Faroe Islands looking for a trace of the great auk, a large flightless seabird that was declared extinct over 175 years ago. He experiences scenic and rugged terrain while on his search.

Most waterways of Alaska are still unexplored, and local folklore tells of hidden channels and monstrous beasts lurking in the depths. One of the most terrifying of all those beasts is said to live in Lake Iliamna.
A woman claims to be under attack from an unseen force. Could it be linked to a Native American legend about a mysterious race of giants?

The team explore Chillingham, Britain's most haunted castle. Hostile spirits are said to roam the mediaeval building, seeking vengeance where thousands died in brutal battles on its grounds or by horrifying tortures in its dungeons.

Gordon is back in Woodland Park, Colorado, for the conclusion of his attempt to help struggling Italian restaurant Mangia Mangia avoid ruin. Will harassed owner Julie ever be reconciled with her out-of-control head chef?
A kid discovers the secret headquarters of a powerful superhero hidden beneath his home and must defend it with his group of friends when villains attack.

Live-action version of the classic stone-age cartoon series. Fred Flintstone donates his family savings to help neighbour Barney Rubble and wife Betty adopt a child, much to the dismay of mother-in-law Pearl. To return the favour, Barney swaps slabs with Fred in an aptitude test, resulting in Fred's being promoted and becoming involved in an embezzlement plot, while Barney is left in the dole queue.
Inspired by Ned Flanders, Homer turns to prayer in the hope of changing his lot in life. After he is injured coming out of church, he sues for damages and is awarded the church itself.
When Bart discovers the existence of an embarrassing TV commercial he appeared in as a baby, and that Homer spent the money he earned, he sues for emancipation and moves out of the house.
At an animal retirement home, a monkey holds Bart hostage in her cage. Marge learns of the kidnapping on the news, and must figure out how to get her son back.
Homer's obsession with Lenny's new plasma TV prompts Marge to enter the family in sweepstakes, and they win a trip to the Fox Studio Lot.
Homer is sent to work in India, where he is worshipped as a god by his new colleagues, but why do they like him so much?
The family star in three tales set at sea: the journey of the Mayflower, the mutiny on the Bounty, and the capsizing of a cruise ship.

When the new school principal splits the school in two, separating the boys from the girls, Lisa dresses as a boy called Jake so that she can attend maths classes. Bart soon learns that his new friend is in fact his sister.

p.t: LEGO Masters: Grand Masters of the Galaxy [NEW]
p.d: The teams build above-and-below designs, on top of and inside a fishtank, based on historical eras of civilisation, with a creature lurking beneath. Whose creations can stay intact submerged in water?

Sparks fly when Gordon visits Blue Island brunch spot Love on the Blu, where there's no love lost between shouty 'boss lady' Valencia and her struggling staff. Can Gordon convince Valencia to confront the changes needed to save her business?
A top-secret spy agency recruits an uncouth but promising street kid into its highly competitive training programme, just as a twisted technological genius threatens the world.

This week, the armchair critics have been watching 'Oprah with Meghan and Harry', 'BBC News (Royal Response)', 'Good Morning Britain (Piers Morgan)', 'Paranormal Lockdown UK', 'The Celebrity Circle For Stand Up To Cancer' and more.

Britain's sharpest armchair critics share more of their insightful and passionate takes on the week's biggest and best shows, including 'Line of Duty', 'Ant & Dec's Saturday Night Takeaway', 'This Is My House' and more.

p.t: Tad the Lost Explorer and the Emerald Tablet
p.d: An explorer races across the far corners of the planet to stop the curse of the Emerald Tablet before things get really out of hand.
Californian aristocrat Don Diego Vega returns from Spain to find his homeland terrorised by a tyrannical governor. Casting aside his noble birth, he dons a mask to fight for justice and the people.

Fritz Lang's sprawling saga about the laying of the first transcontinental telegraph wires. Former bank robber Vance joins the Western Union telegraph company as they construct a link between Omaha and Salt Lake City.

Luther Krank, fed up with the commercialism of Christmas, decides to skip the holiday and go on holiday with his wife, an easy decision to make with their daughter away anyway, but when she suddenly decides to come home, uproar ensues in the rush to celebrate Christmas at the last minute.

Slapstick film about a divorced actor who is willing to go to any lengths to get his children back, even posing as a matronly Scottish housekeeper. His family, taken in by the disguise, decide to employ the eccentric but apparently capable widow, and everyone is happy with the arrangement - until the mother's old boyfriend reappears and tries to become a father figure to the children.
Two white South Africans, imprisoned for working on behalf of the African National Congress, are determined to escape from the notorious Pretoria Prison.
Struggling to survive with her father after the collapse of Earth's ecosystem, 13-year-old Vesper must use her wits, strength and biohacking abilities to fight for the future.

Ben Hopkins' impressive directorial debut is a mythical mystery set in a Jewish shtetl in 19th-century Central Europe. Simon Magus is a simple-minded man revered for his reputed magical powers. Into his life comes the devilish Sirius whose aim is to corrupt both the Jewish and Roman Catholic communities using Magus as the unwitting deus ex machina.

They head out into the night, full of youthful life and promise, but they never come back. Can clues that come from behind bars help solve the mysteries that surround the disturbing disappearances of these two women?

They are the victims of shootings that seem senseless. Who would want them dead? Did these two young people get tangled up with the wrong crowds? And will anyone be held accountable for their murders?

After struggles in their youth, they are setting out on new paths with new hope but then the unthinkable happens. Their horrific murders are chilling. Who would kill them in such a violent way? Did they have any idea how much danger they were in?

Timothy Bass had got away with murder for decades, telling his wife, Gina, that he enjoyed working the night shift to make extra money. Gina believed him until she uncovered his secret and was left wondering what evil her husband had done.

It never occurred to Shirley Gaskins that the father she adored could be one of the most prolific serial killers in America, but the more people vanished without explanation, the harder it was to deny.
A woman must face the hellish truth about her troublemaking son when he commits a monstrous crime. She must see how much a mother's love for her son can withstand.

When Steven Crittenden confesses to his brother, Bryant, and then swears him to secrecy, Bryant faces the toughest decision of his life: whether to keep the secret and risk letting a murderer get away with it or tell the truth and betray his family.

Tattoo artist Amber Andrews and snowboarder Brandon Duran have a tumultuous marriage. When love turns to venomous hate, a shocking secret breaks the surface and reveals a betrayal that leads to murder.
Terri Lemoine and Sean Vincent Gillis lived a quiet life for 10 years, until it was revealed Gillis was living a double life as a serial killer.
In 2007, a devastating house fire in Dallas Township, Pennsylvania, reveals the nearly decapitated body of a pornographic film director.

In May 2013, 36-year-old Army veteran Maribel Ramos disappears from her Orange, California flat without a trace. Suspecting foul play, investigators devise a unique surveillance strategy to track her down and uncover some disturbing evidence.

p.d: Tom Allen celebrates backstage bloopers and live blunders featuring the world's finest TV shows and stars. Featuring Jimmy Carr, Judi Love, Paddy McGuinness, James Martin, Susanna Reid, David Mitchell, Richard Osman, The Real Housewives of Cheshire and many more, the cock-ups include a fire alarm wrecking the recording of Coronation Street.
Join Stephen Mulhern as Mark gets his chance to take on the Banker - he may choose to take an offer from the Banker in exchange for what's in his box or hold out until the end and be rewarded.

With only eight places available on each team, the coaches must choose carefully as they search for the UK's most exciting singing talent. And for the first time, the Rewind button gives them the chance to bring back an artist they regret letting go.
Det Chris Loudon uncovers suspicious behaviour from the police in the 70s. To prove Lindahl's guilt once and for all, Loudon visits Lindahl's grave and oversees an exhumation of his body.
Fern Britton, Dominic Brunt and Kelle Bryan all try to "say what they see" as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win a 50,000-pound jackpot for their chosen charity.

p.t: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
p.d: Big-screen adaptation of the best-selling novel by J. K. Rowling about an 11-year-old boy living with his cruel aunt and uncle who learns that he is the orphaned son of powerful wizards. Harry is offered a place at Hogwarts, a prestigious boarding school for wizards, where he begins piecing together the mystery of his parents' deaths with the help of his new-found friends.
News from the world of entertainment.

The iconic house has had a fresh lick of paint and is ready to welcome a brand-new cast of housemates from all walks of life as they take up residence in the Big Brother house.

p.t: Olivia Attwood: The Price of Perfection
p.d: Over 1.6 million Brits say they've tried so-called skinny jabs, with average users losing up to a fifth of their body weight. For many, GLP-1s felt miraculous, for others, the aftershocks hit hard. Olivia investigates the possible side effects.
Quagmire's war hero father is in town and his proud son can't wait to introduce him to his friends. Little does the town of Quahog know that Quagmire Snr is about to have a sex-change operation.
Meg plans her wedding to an unexpected Quahog resident; Peter's arms are torn off, and he is left with tiny hands that have yet to grow back.
After realising that he has missed every milestone in Steve's life, Stan makes a desperate attempt to bond with his son by creating a busty blonde bombshell alias, Phyllis, whom he sends Steve's way.

Poirot takes a holiday at a stylish Devon hotel, only to find himself in the middle of another mystery when a guest is found murdered. Suspicion falls on the victim's husband and several other guests, and Poirot is forced to use all his powers of observation and human insight in order to solve the complex case.

It is April 1912, and news arrives of the sinking of the Titanic with the loss of Downton's heir James and his son Patrick. The Dowager Countess Violet hopes that the title and estate will pass on to the current Earl Robert's oldest daughter Mary. However, Robert decides not to name Mary his heir, and after discovering that a distant cousin is set to inherit instead, invites the young man to Downton.

Matthew Crawley and his mother Isobel arrive at Downton, and Isobel and the Dowager Countess Violet find their views clashing from the outset. Matthew has difficulty settling in to this new life, and the staff do little to ease his discomfort. Meanwhile, Carson is mortified when confronted by his past, but finds an ally in an unexpected quarter. Elsewhere, Violet attempts to promote a match between Matthew and Mary.

When Cora invites Evelyn Napier to stay at Downton, he brings along his friend Kemal Pamuk, an attaché at the Turkish Embassy. Pamuk is attracted to the eldest daughter Mary, but he later suffers a fatal heart attack in her room. Mary turns to her mother for help, but they are not the only ones who know that Pamuk was in Mary's room that night. Meanwhile, the staff find out that Housemaid Gwen is taking a correspondence course.

The fair arrives in the village and Mrs Hughes finds herself the centre of speculation when she meets a former suitor who makes her question her position at Downton. Also, Violet and Isobel are in conflict over a medical ailment affecting Molesley. Elsewhere, Carson fears there is a thief at Downton.

As the village prepares for its annual flower show, Isobel and Violet clash over Violet's long-held Best Bloom title. Meanwhile, Daisy is unable to get over what she witnessed on the night of Pamuk's death, and Mary is introduced to a potential suitor, but she thinks he is too old and stuffy - and she seems to be more interested in Matthew.

After the sudden death of his wife, a much-needed holiday for DCI Joe Mottram with his daughter Angelica is interrupted when he is called upon by his in-laws to clear the name of a relative who has been accused of murder.

A British tourist is found dead at the foot of a cliff, but did she fall or was she pushed? When Elena gives a baking lesson that makes Joe re-examine the evidence, it results in the discovery of a decisive clue that blows the case wide open.

Each year, the village of Angel's Rise hosts the Psychic Fayre. Founded by the Saint-Stephens family in memory of their late daughter, the event attracts mediums, psychics and followers of the occult. When a body is found surrounded by ritual symbols on the eve of the festival, Barnaby must step into the spiritual world to find the killer.

In the tranquil village of Midsomer Worthy, the local writers' circle is eagerly anticipating a visit from a best-selling novelist, but the aspiring authors are about to witness a sequence of gruesome events far stranger than any fiction.
Lane finds herself in charge of an investigation involving the death of two drug dealers. Meanwhile, serious attempts are made to discredit Wycliffe.

The killer escapes when Monica is distracted by saving Philly. Nichol realises his mum is having an affair with Stephen. Desperate, Monica uses a press conference to provoke the killer. Nichol tells Barclay about Bethany's affair and he attacks Stephen, leading to his arrest. Monica gets information which points to James being the killer and they arrest him. Monica goes home, but wakes to discover that the killer has murdered Philly.
Mildred discovers that George has been writing love letters to another woman. He refuses to discuss it, and a marriage counsellor is brought in.
A daily delivery of bespoke Mindfulness content designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection.
Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

Morse is concerned about a murder case believed closed after the death of the accused, as a fifth victim's body is still to be accounted for. Morse is convinced that the body, that of a single woman on a day trip to Oxford, is in Wytham Woods. However, her bag was found at Blenheim Lake and when a body is discovered there, Morse and Lewis are assigned to the case.

Poirot takes a holiday at a stylish Devon hotel, only to find himself in the middle of another mystery when a guest is found murdered. Suspicion falls on the victim's husband and several other guests, and Poirot is forced to use all his powers of observation and human insight in order to solve the complex case.

It is April 1912, and news arrives of the sinking of the Titanic with the loss of Downton's heir James and his son Patrick. The Dowager Countess Violet hopes that the title and estate will pass on to the current Earl Robert's oldest daughter Mary. However, Robert decides not to name Mary his heir, and after discovering that a distant cousin is set to inherit instead, invites the young man to Downton.

Matthew Crawley and his mother Isobel arrive at Downton, and Isobel and the Dowager Countess Violet find their views clashing from the outset. Matthew has difficulty settling in to this new life, and the staff do little to ease his discomfort. Meanwhile, Carson is mortified when confronted by his past, but finds an ally in an unexpected quarter. Elsewhere, Violet attempts to promote a match between Matthew and Mary.

When Cora invites Evelyn Napier to stay at Downton, he brings along his friend Kemal Pamuk, an attaché at the Turkish Embassy. Pamuk is attracted to the eldest daughter Mary, but he later suffers a fatal heart attack in her room. Mary turns to her mother for help, but they are not the only ones who know that Pamuk was in Mary's room that night. Meanwhile, the staff find out that Housemaid Gwen is taking a correspondence course.

The fair arrives in the village and Mrs Hughes finds herself the centre of speculation when she meets a former suitor who makes her question her position at Downton. Also, Violet and Isobel are in conflict over a medical ailment affecting Molesley. Elsewhere, Carson fears there is a thief at Downton.

As the village prepares for its annual flower show, Isobel and Violet clash over Violet's long-held Best Bloom title. Meanwhile, Daisy is unable to get over what she witnessed on the night of Pamuk's death, and Mary is introduced to a potential suitor, but she thinks he is too old and stuffy - and she seems to be more interested in Matthew.

After the sudden death of his wife, a much-needed holiday for DCI Joe Mottram with his daughter Angelica is interrupted when he is called upon by his in-laws to clear the name of a relative who has been accused of murder.

A British tourist is found dead at the foot of a cliff, but did she fall or was she pushed? When Elena gives a baking lesson that makes Joe re-examine the evidence, it results in the discovery of a decisive clue that blows the case wide open.

Each year, the village of Angel's Rise hosts the Psychic Fayre. Founded by the Saint-Stephens family in memory of their late daughter, the event attracts mediums, psychics and followers of the occult. When a body is found surrounded by ritual symbols on the eve of the festival, Barnaby must step into the spiritual world to find the killer.

In the tranquil village of Midsomer Worthy, the local writers' circle is eagerly anticipating a visit from a best-selling novelist, but the aspiring authors are about to witness a sequence of gruesome events far stranger than any fiction.
Lane finds herself in charge of an investigation involving the death of two drug dealers. Meanwhile, serious attempts are made to discredit Wycliffe.

The killer escapes when Monica is distracted by saving Philly. Nichol realises his mum is having an affair with Stephen. Desperate, Monica uses a press conference to provoke the killer. Nichol tells Barclay about Bethany's affair and he attacks Stephen, leading to his arrest. Monica gets information which points to James being the killer and they arrest him. Monica goes home, but wakes to discover that the killer has murdered Philly.
Mildred discovers that George has been writing love letters to another woman. He refuses to discuss it, and a marriage counsellor is brought in.
Action from across the day's fixtures in the Football League, including Derby v Birmingham, Middlesbrough v Norwich and Swansea v Burnley in the Championship.

Bodie and Doyle stalk East German agents who are blackmailing Government employee John Copeland. The life of his daughter Sandy is threatened unless he hands over top-secret plans for a new jet-engine tank.

A CIA agent is murdered in London, prompting CI5 into launching a fake arms deal with the terrorists who were responsible for the killing. But the terrorists uncover the plot, take Bodie hostage and turn him into a walking time bomb.

After catching some smaller specimens, they crack the tactics and bait code, but will they bank that elusive 30lber before the end of the trip?

First to open up is the musically-themed Harmony B&B in Torquay, where Dutch couple Hans MacDaniel and Monica Van Der Meij hope to wow their guests on the English Riviera.
Flying the flag on day two are Norfolk couple Jenny and Richard Harmer, from Chimneys B&B in North Walsham.
Essex girls Bev and Caroline entertain guests at their suitably blingy Wordsworth B&B in Cockermouth, Cumbria.
It's the last B&B visit of the week, and Geordie mother and daughter Leslie and Emily Gray play hosts at the Park Farm Guest House.

Laura Hamilton heads to the stunning coastal town of Paralimni in eastern Cyprus to help Yvonne and Tony find a holiday home for the whole family to enjoy. With a budget of £80,000, Laura shows them five impressive properties.

Greg and Tina want a holiday home in western Cyprus to share with all their family. Helping them find the perfect place is property expert Leah Charles-King, who shows them the very best of what their £190,000 budget can buy.

Nick and Rose want a holiday home on the Caribbean island of Barbados, to spend up to six months a year enjoying the climate and golf facilities. Craig Rowe shows them what £550k can buy.

Ben Hillman jets off to Portugal's Silver Coast to help mum and daughter Maria and Jess find their dream holiday home. Maria, who is originally from Lisbon, has been living in the UK for almost 40 years but now wants a holiday home.

Chris and Jane are planning a permanent move to Lot-et-Garonne in the southwest of France with their dog, Loki, and they're looking for a detached house on the edge of a small village. Danni Menzies shows them what their £200k can buy.

Rock Riffs, Indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2000 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy and loads more!

p.d: From our sister channel NOW 90s, Def Leppard's lead singer Joe Elliott with a 3-hour journey through the decade - 30 killer tracks hand-picked.
These are the legendary rock stars that made the 80s! Expect Meat Loaf, Bonnie Tyler, Queen, Bon Jovi, AC/DC, Iron Maiden & loads more!
Follow Australian Customs and Border Protection officers as they attempt to enforce the country's various quarantine, customs, immigration and finance laws.
Immigration puts a Chilean tourist under the lie detector. An upset passenger begins to strip to prove his innocence. Customs look over what may be Australia's most expensive wine import.
A relentless officer has a run-in with an unsuspecting passenger. Meanwhile, quarantine find an animal's head in the mail.
A traffic stop turns into a foot chase into the woods; a disgruntled boss works with police to get a former employee arrested; a daughter is forced to call the cops on her mum after an altercation.

A traffic stop leads to a drug arrest with the suspect hiding drugs in an unusual place; a shattered windscreen leads to a domestic violence arrest; police are forced to subdue a man harassing and throwing laundry beads at people.
Buckle up for shocking wipe-outs, spectacular crash landings, animal road rage, and hilariously embarrassing moments, all caught on camera.
Buckle up for shocking crashes, miraculous escapes and COVID nightmares from all four corners of the globe, all caught on camera.

The team contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys while vet nurse Nick hunts for natural remedies to treat a wallaby's gut ailment. Elsewhere, the staff ponder a stuck baby bat, and vet Karina operates on a barn owl's fractured wing.
Aggressive predators, extreme weather and lively joeys can make the task of bringing up baby challenging for mother kangaroos.
In the Barclays WSL, ⚽ [EPL] Aston Villa play host to ⚽ [EPL] Manchester City.
A man tries to pass the blame onto his travelling companion after being caught by Customs for a very sinister reason; a targeted immigration raid.
Almost eight years after the murder of Becky Godden-Edwards, police finally solved the tragic killing after officers arrested a cab driver for taking the life of Sian O'Callaghan in 2011.
In 1980, a woman died in a seemingly accidental house fire, but one police officer spotted signs that something more sinister was at play in the tragic death of mother-of-one Susan Lowson.
Celebrate the world of crazed pick-up drivers, technology gone haywire and extreme storms causing mayhem. Plus helping hands, taxi troubles, and shocking surprises too.
From rambunctious rammers to disastrous driving conditions, join us for a brand-new session of 'Caught on Dashcam'!
Aviva and Koki make a catapult, while Chris and Martin set out to learn everything they can about grasshoppers and their jumping powers.

Everyone is in for a bit of a shock when a couple appear claiming that Luke is actually their missing son, Ashley. After a DNA test backs up their story, Luke is forced to go with them. Can Sarah Jane get to the bottom of this baffling mystery?

Luke comes to the realisation his "parents" are not human, and Sarah Jane discovers a traitor is closer to home than she thinks. With her old enemies triumphant, it seems that Sarah Jane has finally been defeated.
Tilda is determined to get back to her perfect camp plan and stop Ginny from leaving. Meanwhile, Ruby is desperate to get the Brighthawks thrown off camp and safely away from the aliens.
The latest stories making the headlines both at home and abroad during the past seven days.
Remi stands up to Beau, Sonny's lies catch up with him, and Levi is impatient with his recovery.
Sonny's world collapses, Tane sets a trap, and David's search for Beau ramps up.

Across Thailand's myriad landscapes, animals face a constant challenge to find food. Many are locked in a deadly battle either to capture or evade, while others must rely on their wits, guile and tenacity to win their prize.
Xudum lionesses struggle to feed their young; rising floodwaters push male leopards closer together as leopard mum Lediba and cheetah mum Pobe fight to keep their cubs alive.
Exploring Fermanagh's Cuilcagh Lakelands Geopark before heading east to Wexford's Tintern Trails.

p.t: Are You There God? It's Me, Margaret.
p.d: Eleven-year-old Margaret moves to a new town and starts to contemplate everything about life, friendship and adolescence. She relies on her mother, who offers loving support, and her grandmother, who's coming to terms with finding happiness.
Anais begins to cement a relationship with her new police 'family', and finds evidence that her sister had been taking a Class A drug before she died.
Frasier begins a new career at the university, determined to be taken seriously as an academic but finds that a nearly twenty year stint as a daytime talk show host is not easy to escape.
Freddy aims to show his father that he is not just a firefighter, but rather part of a noble and fulfilling cause. However, he picks the worst possible day to invite Frasier to the firehouse.
Nationwide is in Kinsale in County Cork where a living 9/11 memorial on a hill near the town draws locals and visitors to the site.
Congregations from ten Christian churches gather in St Peter's Catholic Church in Bray to mark the start of the week of prayer for Christian Unity.
Ornithologist Seán Ronayne is on a mission to record the call of every bird species in Ireland. His journey reveals the beauty and importance of sound.

Maggie Molloy is on a mission to find Ireland's cheapest homes.
When a rock band reunion ends in murder, Jack and Kate are thrust into a case riddled with secrets and a meticulously-planned alibi, before unveiling a killer hiding in plain sight.
Jane Mangan is joined by Emmet McNamara, Fran Berry and Lisa O'Neill for the Irish Champions Festival. Commentary: Richard Pugh.

The latest national and international news headlines.

Hotel experts Francis and John Brennan are on a mission to restore the fortunes of hospitality businesses all around Ireland. They use their expertise to help all manner of struggling businesses, including guesthouses, hotels, hostels, and more.
Katie goes back to a time when Ireland had the best health service in Europe, there's a Los Angeles-bound pilot who 'accidentally' lands in Baldonnel, Star Trek reunifies Ireland.
Following the daily dramas, domestic and professional, of the residents of Carrigstown in Dublin, which has numerous landmarks that the residents frequent.

Ballard and Gharty investigate the mysterious case of a young woman found strangled in the park.
The suspicious suicides of two Baltimore businessmen bring Detectives Munch, Ballard, Bayliss and Pembleton together to uncover the secrets; Detective Lewis comes back.
Retired Detective Thomas Finnegan helps the homicide squad when the unsolved 1932 murder of a girl comes to light. Based on a real case.
The murder of a prominent judge challenges Detectives Pembleton and Bayliss, and during questioning, Junior Bunk seizes a gun and threatens his interrogators.

Oz strives to protect his family and his enterprise; Sofia uncovers a shocking truth.
Truths are revealed as the power struggle between Oz and Sofia comes to a head.

Iris is stripped of everything she's built. She escapes the island and contacts online conspiracy theorist Alfie, who arrives in Rome.

A moment of unexpected vulnerability and a high-profile romance unleash a storm of turmoil for Shane and Ilya.

Full deferred coverage of St Kilda v Fremantle in the fifth round of the AFLW season. AFL Women's is Australia's national semi-professional Australian rules football league for female players and eighteen teams will be participating in the competition. There are many players from Ireland playing in the Women's AFL, including Ladies Gaelic Football players Niamh Kelly, Vikki Wall, Sarah Rowe, Orla O'Dwyer and many more.

Celebrating and taking a fresh look at the songs of our schooldays.

Food has always been like a language, telling the story and culture of the country it came from. In this series, Kirsten and Allie meet people who have moved to Ireland, and they get a taste of the food they have brought with them.

Junior Eurovision Éire is back! Hundreds will apply, but only ten will be chosen by our judges. These ten will go on to compete in-studio for the chance to sing for Ireland in this year's Junior Eurovision Song Contest!
One game, two dice, and three teams competing against each other to take home the jackpot. A Deis is an exciting game show with three rounds and three teams.
Gradam Ceoil TG4 honours and celebrates the musical heroes of our age. This year the awards will be broadcast live from the University Concert Hall, Limerick.
Timothy West and Prunella Scales embark on their most ambitious voyage ever, travelling the waterways of India. In this episode, they explore the extraordinary backwaters of Kerala.
Timothy West and Pru Scales strike out onto the rarely navigated Brahmaputra river in the far north of India, where they meet a community of monks and hitch a ride on an elephant.
Robbie mends a leaky pump on the Naughty Lass on the Grand Union Canal. In Watford, he visits a TV legend's home and buys gas from a friendly fuel boat.
Robbie navigates the wintry Grand Union Canal while preparing for Christmas and narrowly avoids flooding his boat in a tricky staircase lock.
Robbie Cumming journeys through Royal Leamington Spa and the historic town of Warwick with its medieval castle.

Simon travels down the east coast of Australia. The final part of his journey begins in Surfer's Paradise, near the city of Gold Coast. Then, in the East Coast suburbs, Simon joins a vet and his team who rescue and treat injured koalas. In Sydney, Simon investigates attitudes to immigration among Australians. Finally, Simon takes to the air as he travels to Melbourne - arriving just in time for Australia Day.
Simon Reeve sets off on the first leg of his journey around Turkey. He visits Istanbul and the beaches and crystal clear waters of the Aegean Sea, before ending up at the war-torn border with Syria.
Robbie gets stuck in the mud in Woodseaves Cutting and explores the charming canal-side village of Kinver in Staffordshire.
Robbie navigates the mighty River Severn and takes an unexpected bath as he tumbles at the Tardebigge lock flight in Worcestershire.
On the last leg of his journey across England, Robbie crosses an epic aqueduct near Stratford-upon-Avon and gets stuck in a lock in central Birmingham.

Narrowboater Robbie Cumming begins his 170-mile journey across the north of England and soon runs into difficulty when he encounters a propeller problem in Wigan and runs aground in Blackburn. Nevertheless, he pushes on to navigate a true wonder of the waterways: the Burnley Embankment.

Narrowboater and film-maker Robbie Cumming crosses the Pennines on the picturesque Leeds and Liverpool Canal, and lends a hand to hire boaters in Gargrave, North Yorkshire. He also encounters Bingley Five Rise Locks, a wonder of the inland waterways.

Jump on board with narrowboater Robbie Cumming as he explores the Victorian village of Saltaire on the Leeds and Liverpool Canal, moors up in Leeds and goes in search of an abandoned waterway on the Aire and Calder Navigation.
Derek heads north to pick up a 1954 Morgan +4 coupe in mint condition and believed to be just one of three still on the road.
Derek travels to Southwold to pick up a superb Hillman Avenger. Dave is in Rotherham collecting a sought-after Alfa Romeo.

p.t: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
p.d: Joining Alan this time are Dame Sheila Hancock, who discusses her stellar career, and actor Jeremy Swift to talk about 'Ted Lasso'. We also celebrate the setter, one of our favourite dog breeds, Lesley Joseph goes on safari, and we have fun with rum!

Gaby Roslin and Dr Bolu Eso are in Birmingham, celebrating the extraordinary bond between people and animals. At a specialist veterinary hospital, Bolu follows Labrador Bobbie as he undergoes pioneering laser surgery, while another dog presents the team with a neurological mystery. Gaby meets Chloe and her assistance dog Cinna and discovers how they work together, before learning about StreetVet, the charity providing free veterinary care to the pets of people experiencing homelessness.
The latest national and international news.

Alan goes traditional with a twist, creating an elegant tea-garden for a charity volunteer known as the Cake Lady - a one-woman bakery - who has made cakes for more than 9,000 injured servicemen and women. The twist is that this new garden in Birmingham will have a fully equipped kitchen to bake in, and raised beds full of fresh ingredients to add to pies and cakes. Alan creates a colourful living wall that's perfect for any gardening novice, and Katie shares the tricks to a successful balcony.

Oli Bell and Francesca Cumani present coverage of racing from Doncaster and The Curragh. Doncaster stages the fourth day of the St Leger meeting, where the Sceptre Stakes and Mallard Handicap are the feature races, whilst at The Curragh it's the second day of Irish Champions Weekend. Analysis from Jason Weaver and Leonna Mayor, reporting from Matt Chapman and Luke Harvey, with commentary from Mark Johnson.
Adil Ray hosts the game of words as Good Morning Britain's Kate Garraway and This Morning's Ashley James battle pop legends Toyah Willcox and Carol Decker to win big money for charity.

TV and radio presenter Vernon Kay, former footballer and property presenter Dion Dublin, and much-loved actress Amanda Barrie put their wits to the test to discover if any of them have what it takes to master the machine.
The latest headlines from around the world. Followed by a national weather forecast.
News and weather from across Northern Ireland.

Bradley Walsh asks the questions as Rich from Peterborough, Clare from York, Paddy from Manchester and Alys from the Vale of Glamorgan join forces in the hope of winning some money - all they've got to do is beat a Chaser.

Lee Mack presents the game show where the questions aren't about general knowledge but logic, brainpower and common sense. 100 contestants begin each edition, who'll face the final question, which only 1 per cent of the population can get right.

Gary Lineker continues to put the celebrities through their paces as the competition intensifies. With the boxes opening in ever more weird and wonderful locations, the fear of the unknown shows no sign of easing - but there's a shift in mood. The camaraderie is fading, replaced by growing mistrust. Singer JB Gill has played a fair and honest game but some begin to question whether he's as saintly as he seems.
When a colleague's life is in danger, Lana and the team do all they can to rescue them as Counter Terror race to uncover the true identity of the bombers.
The latest national and international news.

p.t: It'll Be Alright on the Night
p.d: Tom Allen celebrates backstage bloopers and live blunders featuring the world's finest TV shows and stars. Featuring Jimmy Carr, Judi Love, Paddy McGuinness, James Martin, Susanna Reid, David Mitchell, Richard Osman, The Real Housewives of Cheshire and many more, the cock-ups include a fire alarm wrecking the recording of Coronation Street.
Michelle and Hannah help a grandmother who's experiencing a serious panic attack; paramedics assist a man with abdominal pain.
Technician Lewis and paramedic Grant assist a woman who was found unconscious on her patio; things take an unexpected turn for Caroline inside the ambulance.
Michelle and Hannah help a six-week-old baby with a suspected case of sepsis, which could be life-threatening; paramedics treat an expectant father with serious burns.
Noel treats Doberman Rolo, who has an aggressive bone tumour, ferret Astrid, who's broken her leg falling off a sofa doing a 'war dance', and puddle-loving Labrador Jeff, who has lifelong arthritis.

Noel treats handsome Dobermann Dexter, who has a serious spinal condition, feisty feline Driver, who's been hit by a car, and sixteen-month-old Newfoundland Bailey, who has developmental elbow disease.
Noel treats eight-year-old Dalmatian Milo, whose squashed spinal cord is causing him constant pain. And Noel attempts to fuse four-year-old Shih Tzu Ollie's elbow in order to save his leg.
Noel treats cockapoo Betsy, who has been receiving treatment after being hit by a van five months ago, but now she has gangrene. Also treated is bijou puppy Angel, who has a genetic deformity.
The emotional story of Noel Fitzpatrick's dog Keira and her recovery after being hit by a car in September 2020.
Pete helps rescue six Chihuahuas from the home of a hoarder and witnesses the emotional handover of a pregnant pug and her sister.
Pete meets Chow Chow Nugget who has a longer stay than planned, three-legged Tetley, and some Belgian Malinois puppies training to be service dogs.
Five celebrities and their dogs take on the world of competitive dog training, learning new skills, building on their relationships with their pets, and vying to be Wagging Rights champion.
A four-year-old girl has her droopy eyelid lifted, a rugby player gets his broken nose reset and a woman has an operation on her wrist after almost a year of agony.
Nick has an ultrasound taken from inside his body to find out if he needs open-heart surgery, and Irene has gel removed from her eye to make her see again.
A man struggles to breathe after injecting himself, while a woman struggles with agonising pain, and a toddler has a seizure.
Paramedics respond to calls regarding a toddler who has drunk a dangerous liquid, a school pupil in pain after dislocating his knee, and a doting husband who appears to be having a stroke.
A horse rider is hit by a car on a country road, leaving both her and her horse with serious injuries. Plus, the centre of Leeds is locked down after a suspicious package is found.

First on the list of farm calls is an agitated cow at Richard Pniewski's farm. Richard is concerned because this new mother has stopped eating, and that's not good for the little calf dependent on her milk to survive.
The deep freeze of late winter has everyone feeling uncomfortable, but the temperatures won't stop Dr Pol from taking on a new home improvement project.
It's Dr Oakley to the rescue when dog Harper gets caught in a prickly situation. Later, she squares off with a muskox and a bear cub undergoes surgery.
Dr Oakley goes to the rescue of a newborn reindeer with a serious injury, and an unexpected guest threatens to scupper her plan as she tries to collar a black bear.
Love is in the air at ZooTampa, but one-horned rhino Johnny misses his love connection.
The ZooTampa family is growing as Ceduna the female koala has a baby inside her pouch.
The staff welcomes rescued manatees to the newly renovated ZooTampa Manatee hospital.
The doctors at Critter Fixer attempt to outfit a duck with a prosthetic leg.

Exploring the secrets of China to reveal the beauty of its hidden kingdoms, with unique access to locations across the country. Five different biomes are explored, from high mountains and tropical jungles to bamboo forests, great plains, and forests.

The Jungles of southern Yunnan are unique in China which is home to its greatest diversity of life. From primates to bears, fishing bats to bees and elephants to caterpillars, this is their story. With abundant resources life here should be easy but to survive, each must find its way to thrive. The creatures here have done exactly that through amazing adaptations some of which are filmed for the very first time.
Nature's Magic Moments bursts with unique animal behaviour in super slow motion, and amazing time-lapse that allows us to see nature with new eyes!
Where the Congo rainforest meets the Atlantic, Gabon's beaches become a rare gathering place for forest elephants, monkeys and even surfing hippos.
In India's deserts, predators and prey battle each other and the harshest of landscapes for food, water, and breeding rights.
India's monsoon forest is a place of sanctuary and extremes. All live by the law of the seasons.
There are new challenges for rescued brown bears, and a bitey harbour seal undergoes an epic rehab journey. An eagle suffers a mysterious injury and a raven gets stuck in a gutter.
Angus raids TV presenter Susannah's couture stash, then helps actress Leslie uncover treasures, memories, and a few famous surprises!
Angus and the team clear out a big house in Whixall, Shropshire. In the house they uncover a hoard of treasures including a Victorian desk set, a hanging lantern and Vogue clothing patterns.
Angus is in Wallsend, Newcastle, to clear out a home that is full of books. He takes interest in a Bechstein piano, a scary vase and a silver loving-cup.

First through the barn doors is Sue Lock, with her daughter Hannah. They have brought Sue's grandmother's leather midwifery bag. They fear the battered old bag is a hopeless case, but Susie Fletcher believes she can nurse it back to life.
Jay Blades and the team restore a whistling wooden statue, a photographer's dark-room timer and an owl inkwell.
Musical instrument restorer Pete Woods is pleased to meet Chris Bassett from Hertfordshire. Chris has brought in his very first musical instrument, which is desperate for some specialist attention.

First to arrive are father and son Herbert and Joshua Klein, with a mantle clock in the shape of a ship for the attention of horologist Steve Fletcher. This treasured item was a gift from Herbert's late grandfather, with whom he had an incredible bond as a child. Born deaf, his grandfather would communicate by pointing and gesturing while Herbert would lip-read.
Angus unearths some ancient Greek and Roman artefacts in Derbyshire. In Kent, Angus is attracted to a curiously well-travelled wardrobe.
Newlyweds face a heartbreaking sale of treasured antiques. And, in Durham, a family parts with dad's railway, but will his watercolour paintings sell?

p.d: Johnny revisits high-end dealers Karl and Mark, where a £900 oil painting tests his resolve. Plus, Johnny considers selling a prized clockwork toy.
